title: Dune Allen "Pickleball Dunes" 108 Woodward Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool- 5 adult bikes- 6- Passenger Low Speed Vehicle- Private pickleball court- Game area with Foosball table- Cornhole board- 2 washer and dryers for convenience- Great location for fishing, kayaking, etc.- Views of Allen Lake- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Pickleball Dunes is where play meets peaceful relaxation! Sleeping 15 guests, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom Dune Allen home is perfect for multiple families or large groups visiting 30A. Enjoy sunny days in the private pool, friendly competitions on the pickleball court, and easy access to the white sand beach and Gulf—only a short 5-minute stroll away!An exterior staircase leads up to the main level of this 3-story property, where a covered porch with Adirondack chairs and a 6-person table encourages unwinding beside swaying palms. Inside, find a vast living space with 2 sofas and armchairs arranged for casual movie nights and gatherings. Blond wood, woven natural fibers, and natural light from the numerous windows create a bright, beachy atmosphere. Artful archways guide guests into the dining area, featuring a lovely wooden table beneath an oyster chandelier and the chef’s kitchen, which boasts high-end appliances and a 3-stool breakfast bar. Pocket doors reveal a cozy den with a couch, TV, games, and access to the back porch with a bar-top table for 6 and stairs to the backyard.Downstairs, a living space, a table for 4, a foosball table, and a full kitchen with a 3-seat breakfast bar await. A stacked washer and dryer add additional convenience to this level’s sleeping accommodations—1 guest bedroom with a comfy king bed and private bathroom, 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and porch access, and 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bunk bed, a full trundle, and porch access. Outside, a cornhole set, a sparkling private pool, and a pickleball court surrounded by lush palm trees and native plants provide a stunning sanctuary.A luxurious third living space with a wraparound sleeper sofa enjoys nature and lake views on the top floor. A TV and 2 armchairs are in the corner, and there’s a desk and Keurig coffee bar for remote work. When it’s time to retire, rest easy in the primary bedroom with a spa-inspired private bathroom. Another stacked washer-and-dryer set completes the level.Pickleball Dunes has everything guests need for a luxurious Dune Allen getaway, including on-site parking, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle for exploring. The Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is across Scenic 30A Highway at the end of Woodward Drive, only a quick walk away. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 15):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed with Full Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Additional Living Area: Game and Sitting Area, Sleeper Sofa and Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Living Area: Common Area with Sleeper Sofa*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.

Sleeping 15 guests, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom Dune Allen home is perfect for multiple families or large groups visiting 30A. Enjoy sunny days in the private pool, friendly competitions on the pickleball court, and easy access to the white sand beach and Gulf—only a short 5-minute stroll away! An exterior staircase leads up to the main level of this 3-story property, where a covered porch with Adirondack chairs and a 6-person table encourages unwinding beside swaying palms. Inside, find a vast living space with 2 sofas and armchairs arranged for casual movie nights and gatherings. Blond wood, woven natural fibers, and natural light from the numerous windows create a bright, beachy atmosphere. Artful archways guide guests into the dining area, featuring a lovely wooden table beneath an oyster chandelier and the chef’s kitchen, which boasts high-end appliances and a 3-stool breakfast bar. Pocket doors reveal a cozy den with a couch, TV, games, and access to the back porch with a bar-top table for 6 and stairs to the backyard. Downstairs, a living space, a table for 4, a foosball table, and a full kitchen with a 3-seat breakfast bar await. A stacked washer and dryer add additional convenience to this level’s sleeping accommodations—1 guest bedroom with a comfy king bed and private bathroom, 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and porch access, and 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bunk bed, a full trundle, and porch access. Outside, a cornhole set, a sparkling private pool, and a pickleball court surrounded by lush palm trees and native plants provide a stunning sanctuary. A luxurious third living space with a wraparound sleeper sofa enjoys nature and lake views on the top floor. A TV and 2 armchairs are in the corner, and there’s a desk and Keurig coffee bar for remote work. When it’s time to retire, rest easy in the primary bedroom with a spa-inspired private bathroom. Another stacked washer-and-dryer set completes the level. Pickleball Dunes has everything guests need for a luxurious Dune Allen getaway, including on-site parking, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle for exploring. The Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is across Scenic 30A Highway at the end of Woodward Drive, only a quick walk away. Book today!
